name: Ambuja Cements Ltd
title: Ambuja Cements Ltd - 500425 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Ambuja's Q4 FY26 cost hit ~INR4,500/t with FY27 cost reduction of only INR250/t and capex cut to INR6,000–6,500 cr; utilisation at acquired Sanghi (57%) and Penna (46%) is the drag, and pricing is still under pressure.

utilisation.quote: Sanghi still remains at around, say, at 57% on cement capacity utilization, while Penna is 46%

capex.quote: for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores.

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR6,000–6,500 cr
triggers.quote: for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores.

triggers.label: Capacity target pushed out to FY30
triggers.quote: the target plans of FY '28, it could move a year or 2, let us say, on a safer side, I would say that FY '30.

triggers.label: Industry price up only ~INR10 in March
triggers.quote: ballpark for the quarter of March, around ballpark INR10. Now with the demand getting a little softer, the pressure on pricing definitely is higher.

triggers.label: Sanghi 57%, Penna 46% utilisation
triggers.quote: Sanghi still remains at around, say, at 57% on cement capacity utilization, while Penna is 46%

triggers.label: Cost reduction only INR250/t in FY27
triggers.quote: cost, we are looking at roughly INR250 a tonne reduction this year and then another reduction of INR250 next year

triggers.label: FY27 volume 80 mt, ~8% growth
triggers.quote: we are expecting it to grow in FY '28 -- '27 by almost, say, 8% to around 80 million -odd tonnes

guidance.quote: we are expecting it to grow in FY '28 -- '27 by almost, say, 8% to around 80 million -odd tonnes
We are expecting to hit capacity of almost 119 million tonnes by end of FY '27.

guidance.value: INR250/t reduction, another INR250 in FY28
guidance.quote: cost, we are looking at roughly INR250 a tonne reduction this year and then another reduction of INR250 next year
for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores.

guidance.metric: Utilisation target for Sanghi and Penna
guidance.value: Raise utilisation by at least 5% to 10%
guidance.quote: the target is to increase the utilization by at least 5% to 10% for these assets

prior_guidance_check.quote: the target plans of FY '28, it could move a year or 2, let us say, on a safer side, I would say that FY '30.

red_flags.label: Cost target missed; Q4 cost ~INR4,500/t vs INR4,000 guided
red_flags.quote: we have achieved a figure of INR4,400 a tonne, which is almost 10% higher to our own target

red_flags.label: Non-core working capital up sharply
red_flags.quote: that non-core working capital ex cash, that seems to have gone up significantly

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow at ACC
red_flags.quote: your ACC's operating cash flows are negative, sharply negative for the year

red_flags.label: Management admits project delays and breakdowns
red_flags.quote: we did not choose the right contractor for execution

evasions.topic: Cost trajectory vs earlier INR4,000 target
evasions.quote: please don't mistaken with INR4,000 as average for the March quarter
which specific non-core you are referring to, for example, you can connect to me offline
I think any guidance on EBITDA will be difficult at this stage.
it would be inappropriate from my side to answer anything on that
